ctaText: Have a specific question about your business?

items.question: Is there really no long-term contract?
items.answer: Correct. It's a month-to-month payment and you can cancel anytime, no penalties or fine print. If you decide to leave, we'll help you export your clients and schedule.

items.question: Do reminders go out from my own WhatsApp number?
items.answer: Yes. On the Essential and Own Brand plans, messages are sent from your official WhatsApp Business number. Your customers see your brand, not ours.

items.question: Do I need to install anything or buy equipment?
items.answer: No. AgenditApp runs 100% in the cloud. You open it from your phone, tablet, or computer. We set everything up with you on a 30-minute call.

items.question: How quickly can I get it up and running?
items.answer: The same day. We help you load your services, hours, and staff, and leave your booking link ready to share.

items.question: What if I'm not very tech-savvy?
items.answer: AgenditApp was built for non-technical people, and our team sets everything up for you for free when you start. If you can send a text message, you can use AgenditApp.

items.question: Can I change plans later?
items.answer: Yes, upgrade or downgrade whenever you want. You only pay the prorated difference for the current month.

items.question: What happens to my data and my clients' data?
items.answer: Your information is encrypted and backed up in the cloud. Only you can access it with your account. We comply with applicable data protection regulations.

items.question: Do you accept bank transfers or cards?
items.answer: Yes. We accept bank transfers and major credit/debit cards.
